title: Website Design in Sycamore, Illinois: A DeKalb County Guide

cover.alt: Concept illustration of a fictional office-and-boutique brand moodboard for a local website; not a Sycamore landmark or business photograph.

figures.title: Build local identity from real business information
figures.summary: The guide favors useful specificity over generic stock content.

items.label: Actual business imagery
items.detail: Use genuine photos when representing the business or its work.

items.label: Specific service content
items.detail: Explain what the business offers instead of repeating boilerplate.

items.label: Honest area coverage
items.detail: Describe service in Sycamore, DeKalb, or surrounding areas only when accurate.

items.label: Consistent public facts
items.detail: Align the website, profiles, and directory contact details.

figures.caption: Content layers drawn from this guide. The cover remains a clearly labeled concept illustration.

figures.title: Separate the commitments before hiring
figures.summary: The hiring checklist covers more than the initial price.

items.label: One-time build
items.detail: Confirm what the total project scope includes.

items.label: Ongoing care
items.detail: Ask what the monthly fee covers and what is extra.

items.label: Account ownership
items.detail: Verify control of domain and hosting access and the exit process.

items.label: Review and delivery
items.detail: Request live examples and clarify accessibility checks, content needs, and timing.

figures.caption: A grouped version of the article's questions, intended to make proposals easier to compare.
